en.headline: High Court jury convicts man of murdering yoga instructor ex-girlfriend
en.dek: A unanimous High Court jury found Lo Chun-ming guilty of murdering Chow Wai-yin at the Ritz-Carlton hotel in 2022; sentencing is set for Friday.
body: The High Court jury returned a unanimous verdict on Thursday, finding former legal assistant Lo Chun-ming guilty of murdering his ex-girlfriend Chow Wai-yin, a 23-year-old yoga instructor, at the Ritz-Carlton hotel in West Kowloon in June 2022.

According to the prosecution, Chow was found in a blood-filled bathtub in the hotel room with more than 40 sharp-force injuries. Lo, who was 28 at the time of the charge, had checked into the hotel the day before and purchased a kitchen knife on Temple Street. He later surrendered with the room keycard.

The court heard that the pair had been in a relationship that ended earlier in 2022. Lo testified that he had intended to take his own life at the hotel after seeing her one last time but lost control after an argument. Sentencing is scheduled for Friday, and Lo has indicated he wishes to submit a mitigation letter.

zh.headline: 高院陪審團一致裁定前男友謀殺瑜伽導師罪成
zh.dek: 高等法院陪審團周四一致裁定勞浚銘謀殺前女友周慧賢罪成，案發於2022年麗思卡爾頓酒店，判刑押後至周五。
body: 高等法院七人陪審團於周四退庭商議約五小時後，一致裁定被告勞浚銘謀殺罪成。死者周慧賢為23歲瑜伽導師，於2022年6月29日至30日期間在西九龍麗思卡爾頓酒店房間內遇害。
控方案情指，周慧賢被發現倒斃於浸滿血水的浴缸內，身上有逾40處刀傷。被告當時28歲，於案發前一天入住酒店，並在廟街購買一把廚房刀。其後他由律師陪同到警署，交出酒店房卡。
案件聽取供詞指，兩人曾為情侶，關係於2022年初結束。被告供稱原打算在酒店內自尋短見，但與死者爭執後失控。法庭押後至周五判刑，被告表示希望撰寫求情信。
